text: 智谱拟通过中金公司发售股份，募集约20亿美元。所得款项将用于：研发和算力资源部署，业务扩张计划，战略投资及潜在收购，以及优化资本结构。发售价格较上一交易日收盘价折让9.96%。文件显示，在此次发售的同时，公司还拟发售201.4亿元人民币、以美元结算的2027年到期零息可转换债券。该债券可转换为公司H股，初始转换价为每股892.50港元。（彭博）
text_en: Zhipu plans to sell shares through CICC to raise about USD 2 billion. The proceeds will be used for: research and development and computing power resource deployment, business expansion plans, strategic investments and potential acquisitions, and optimizing the capital structure. The offering price represents a 9.96% discount to the previous trading day's closing price. Documents show that alongside this offering, the company also plans to offer RMB 20.14 billion of U.S. dollar-settled zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2027. The bonds can be converted into the company's H shares at an initial conversion price of HKD 892.50 per share. (Bloomberg)
